pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: docs/spec/contract.md:717 The contract's per-call ledger row (continued on line 718) has no prompt fingerprint or content digest, so which prompt a given call received cannot be answered from the record, which is the standard's unrecorded-send failure.

techniques.evidence: docs/spec/contract.md:717 The row carries usage tokens (a size) but no fingerprint or digest. Brain::prefix_hash is documented 'for the ledger' (crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/lib.rs:503) yet has no non-test caller, and a search of crates/shadowrunr-engine for digest/sha/prompt-log terms found nothing. The run-level instrument_hash (contract.md:377) is a real version stamp but is not per call.

docs/spec/contract.md:791 The technique bars 'characters divided by a hopeful constant' unless the estimator has known error. The 3.5 and the 15% margin carry no measurement here or in crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/budget.rs:41-43, and 120k is not derived from a model window. The naming of cuts at line 796 does meet the truncation rule.

docs/spec/contract.md:907 The contract fixes a stability-ordered stack and keeps per-segment and per-turn material out of the prefix (lines 316-317). This is specified here; the assembler itself belongs to brain-composition-memory.

docs/spec/contract.md:193 A closed key set with loud failure at load. All nine keys are package-authored persona values, so the trust question reduces to authored, but no class is written at the declaration.

shadowrunr.example.toml:43 No third-party instruction documents are admitted: safe mode excludes harness-injected documents by default, and a search of contract.md for skill, plugin and third-party found none. Setting safe_mode to false would need a fresh look.
